description: Save, CAS-update, or non-destructively archive a reusable skill. Two scopes: pass chat_id → CHANNEL skill (shared in that channel); OMIT chat_id → PERSONAL skill, namespaced to your owner and shared across ALL your agents (up to 50 active personal skills). Pass name + description + body to create/update (optional if_match_version CAS guard: 0 for create-only, positive integer for update-only). Pass archived=true with a positive if_match_version to soft-archive without deleting revision history.

archived.description: Pass true with a positive if_match_version to non-destructively soft-archive (keeps revisions intact and frees active quota).

argument_hint.description: Optional argument hint (e.g. '[target]') stored in YAML frontmatter

body.description: The skill content in markdown — the instructions an agent follows

chat_id.description: Channel to save into (CHANNEL skill). OMIT for a PERSONAL skill (per-owner, follows you across agents).

description.description: One line: what it does / when to use it (required unless archived=true)

doc_id.description: Optional stable id/slug (default: a slug of name). Reuse to update or archive.

if_match_version.description: Optional CAS guard: 0 to create only if absent, positive version to update/archive without overwriting concurrent edits (required when archived=true).

level.description: CHANNEL only: doc tier 1-4 (default 3 = any member may write; 1-2 require channel admin)

trigger.description: Optional slash trigger hint (e.g. '/deploy') stored in YAML frontmatter

name: save_skill
